purpose: Teach: 祐/俊/吾/遙/諒/ゆり/綾/朱

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、隣の祐とコンビニ寄ってたな
lines.en: Riku, you and Yu from next door stopped by the convenience store together, didn't you?
lines.style: Playful accusation with a knowing smirk. Light, teasing lilt on the observation. Not mean—just catching him in something. Quick pace, slight head tilt in the voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、俊と部活で組んでたな、桜
lines.en: You were paired with Shun in club activities, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Casual mirror-back, matching her energy but cooler. A slight uptick of amusement—he's turning her game on her. Even delivery, no rush, comfortable in the back-and-forth.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、国語で「吾輩は猫である」読まされてたな
lines.en: Riku, you had to read 'I Am a Cat' for Japanese class, didn't you?
lines.style: Sarcastic edge softening into genuine curiosity. The tone says 'I'm teasing you' but the pacing is slower, more observant. Not attacking—just noting the funny thing he's dealing with.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、転校生の遙ちゃんと仲良くなったな、桜
lines.en: You got close to Haruka, the transfer student, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Gentle comeback, no barb underneath. His voice lifts slightly with interest—he's genuinely noticing something about her. Warm but still maintaining that cool distance. Steady eye-level delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、サッカー部の諒先輩を尊敬してたな
lines.en: Riku, you really respect Ryo, the senior from soccer club, don't you?
lines.style: Teasing but touched by something sincere underneath. She knows this matters to him. The words come slower, more deliberate. A flicker of genuine affection hidden in the prodding tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ゆり先輩のチョコ嬉しそうだったな、桜
lines.en: You looked pretty happy when Yuri-senpai gave you chocolate, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Sly, small smile in the voice. He's caught her in something that actually pleased her and he's enjoying it. Light, almost conspiratorial. The words land with playful precision but no cruelty.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、隣のクラスの綾と話してたな
lines.en: Riku, you were talking to Aya from the class next door, weren't you?
lines.style: Bright curiosity with a sharper edge underneath. She's fishing for something, testing whether he'll admit it or deflect. Quick, engaged delivery. Watching for his reaction.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、美術で朱色を使うの上手かったな、桜
lines.en: You were really good at using vermillion in art class, Sakura.
lines.style: Genuine praise, almost tender for a second before the cool returns. He's noticing something small and real about her. Slower pace, quieter tone. The words feel slightly unguarded before he catches himself.
